subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should OpenClaw add an explicit one-way A2A dispatch semantic to `sessions_send`, and if so should it be a per-call mode on the existing tool or a separate primitive?
rationale: The current code proves the requested behavior is missing, but choosing the permanent tool/API shape affects core agent semantics, docs, tests, and compatibility with existing A2A conversation workflows.

options.title: Add per-call dispatch mode
options.body: Add a narrow explicit `sessions_send` delivery mode that skips requester ping-pong and target announce unless requested, while keeping the current default unchanged.

options.title: Separate primitive
options.body: Add a new one-way delivery tool or primitive and keep `sessions_send` as the conversation-oriented API, accepting a larger new API surface.

options.title: Defer to guard fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open only as design context while landing narrower fixes for reverse-calls, cycles, and acknowledgement metadata.

recommendation.title: Add per-call dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Add a narrow explicit `sessions_send` delivery mode that skips requester ping-pong and target announce unless requested, while keeping the current default unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter’s history covers multi-agent routing and the broader core sessions/product boundary, making him the best available product-direction owner from the inspected history.
